leadText: A Nursery Aide (Japanese: ほいくし Kindergarten Teacher) is a type of introduced in Generation V. They are normally found near s. They can be considered a different version of the Trainer class. Some will give out Rare Candies when defeated. They normally use Pokémon from a variety of different types. In the Battle Subway, they specialize in Eeveelutions, and in the early stages, either Pokémon or the final evolved forms of first partner Pokémon.

==In animation==
 
=== ===
Daniela, a character of the day who appeared in Here Comes the Trubbish Squad!, is based on this Trainer class, due to the Japanese name of the class. She was shown to run a kindergarten located somewhere between Striaton City and Nacrene City.

=== ===
Another Kindergarten Teacher, , appeared in Kindergarten Chaos!. She works in a kindergarten somewhere between Lumiose City and Camphrier Town.

 ]]
===Pokémon Adventures===
A Nursery Aide was seen in a commercial for the Xtransceiver in Lights, Camera...Action!.
 

==Trivia==
 
In the Japanese, French, German, Spanish, and Korean versions of Black 2 and White 2, Nursery Aide June tells the player that he's a man, but dresses as a woman since his employer only hires women and would only hire him on the condition that he dressed as a woman. This dialogue appears after riding the Ferris wheel together at least twice, and is edited in the English and Italian versions so that June's employer was instead looking for people with more experience.
